statements: CREATE FUNCTION UDF_PlanStability_inline1() { ( SELECT c21 FROM shellTest WHERE type = "right" AND c21 < 5 ) }

CREATE FUNCTION UDF_PlanStability_inline2() { ( SELECT l.c11, r.c21 FROM shellTest l LEFT JOIN shellTest r ON r.type = "right" AND l.c11 = r.c21 AND ANY v IN r.a21 SATISFIES v IN [1,2] END WHERE l.type = "left" AND l.c11 <= 3 ) }

testcase: Set plan stability mode to PREPARED_ONLY
statements: UPDATE system:settings SET plan_stability.mode = "prepared only"
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM system:prepareds WHERE persist IS MISSING AND planPreparedTime IS NOT MISSING
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM QUERY_METADATA._system._query WHERE meta().id LIKE 'ppn::%'
PREPARE udf1 FROM SELECT s.c12 FROM shellTest s WHERE s.c11 > 0 AND s.type = "left" AND ANY v IN UDF_PlanStability_inline1() SATISFIES v.c21 = s.c11 END
